game.name: Destiny 2
game.rules:
# General rules

- Speedrunning is the act of playing a video game with the intent of completing it as fast as possible. Runs will be rejected if this intent is not present, at verifier discretion.
- Original audio must be audible for the whole run. However, runs with limited or no audio may still be verified at verifier discretion.
- Your run may not be tool-assisted in any form, including but not limited to macros, scripts besides the solo script, any form of network manipulation, and cheats.
- Runs with strategies designed around the use of limited time global buffs (such as Solstice Empowerment) will be rejected.
- Strategies exploiting the game's connection-based nature will be reviewed for consistency between fireteams of different player compositions before being permitted.
- Exploits or strategies that Bungie has expressed the intention to patch or have precedent in being patched by Bungie are not permitted until it is clear that they will remain in the game.
- Any glitch listed in [this forum post](https://www.speedrun.com/destiny2/forums/pnnuu) is not allowed in any run.
- For information on artifact mod bans, please see [this thread](https://www.speedrun.com/destiny2/forums/v95ms).

# Submission standards

- Video proof of the entire duration of the run for at least one encounter POV and one POV for each out-of-bounds/skip player is required for all runs. 
- Runs that do not use the activity completion banner as their end condition must demonstrate that the strategy being employed in the run would result in a successful activity completion.
- Supported websites include YouTube, Twitch, and bilibili.
- For top 3 submissions, the POV of the player that makes the first input affecting the run's time is required, and the run will be timed based off of this POV in order to avoid discrepancies.
- Moderators reserve the right to retroactively reject or remove runs where submitted video evidence is deleted, made private, or otherwise inaccessible.
- Corrupted gameplay or gameplay obscured or impacted by overlays may be rejected (non-intrusive overlays such as DDT and threepole are permitted).

# Starting conditions

- Starting with any weapon equipped is allowed, provided that it is not fired or prepped in any way (Lament cannot be charged, Izanagi's Burden cannot be honed, Eager Edge cannot be active, etc.).
- Any run utilizing an ability that a player would not have if they had started the activity immediately upon load-in may be rejected at verifier discretion.
- Valid starting positions are limited to where a player could randomly spawn upon loading into the activity (read category rules for exceptions).

# Timing

- Runs generally end on one of the five following conditions (see category rules for exceptions):

1. Boss healthbar flash/death
2. First frame of mission complete banner
3. First frame of mission summary line
4. Last frame of level visible
5. Frame after interact is filled (empty circle)

  ![](/static/blob/kzwo3d8e.png)

- After cutscenes and loading screens, timer resumes on either the first input that affects the run or optionally when the level becomes visible for the player with the slowest load.
- Runs with strategies involving wipe screens or rejoins will have wipe screens equalized to 17s in raids and 7s in dungeons and levels (timed from leaderboard black screen to first visible spawn frame), while rejoins will be equalized to simulate perfect load times (equalization specifics can be found in category rules).

For more information on category-specific rules, check the individual category rules by clicking "Show rules" at the top right corner of a leaderboard. If you have further questions, feel free to head to our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/d2speedrun).

categories.name: Salvation's Edge
categories.rules:
# Start and end conditions

- Timer starts on the first input that affects the run.
- Timer ends on the frame the final boss' health is fully depleted.

# Pauses and equalizations

- The time between the frame the 2-3 end friendship door opens and the first frame of the interact prompt filling to start the Repository encounter will be set to 28 seconds.

categories.rules:
# Start and end conditions

- Timer starts on the first input that affects the run.
- Timer ends on the frame the final boss' health is fully depleted.

categories.name: Root of Nightmares
categories.rules:
# Start and end conditions

- Timer starts on the first input that affects the run.
- Timer ends on the frame the Mission Complete banner appears.

# Pauses and equalizations

- 4 seconds will be subtracted from any run that successfully completes the Cataclysm encounter challenge in order to compensate for the objective update delay caused by the spawning of the challenge chest.

categories.name: King's Fall
categories.rules:
# Start and end conditions

- Timer starts on the first input that affects the run.
- Timer ends on the frame the final boss' health is fully depleted.

# Pauses and equalizations

- Timer pauses on the first frame that the Warpriest flag is planted in the ground (white mist emitted from flag base), and resumes on first input after the flag becomes accessible.
- Timer pauses when the Golgoroth door begins to open, and resumes on the first input of any player in the fireteam. Any players participating in the transition to Golgoroth may not rejoin during this period, and the players in the encounter must start Golgoroth when the rejoining players successfully merge with the fireteam.
- If any player leaves after Golgoroth dies, the time between Golgoroth's health being fully depleted and the first input of any player rejoining the fireteam will be set to 53 seconds. Any additional time spent beyond 30 seconds triggering the Daughters objective after Golgoroth's death will be added to this 53 second equalization.

# Miscellaneous

- Placing a perma flag at the start of the Daughters encounter is currently disallowed due to the uncertainty behind its consistency between players with different connections.

categories.name: Vow of the Disciple
categories.rules:
# Start and end conditions

- Timer starts on the first input that affects the run.
- Timer ends on the frame the final boss' health is fully depleted.

# Pauses and equalizations

- The time between Caretaker's health being fully depleted and the first input of any rejoining fireteam member will be set to either 50 seconds (if the rejoins happen after Caretaker dies) or 30 seconds (if the rejoins happen after main damage).

categories.name: Vault of Glass
categories.rules:
# Start and end conditions

- Timer starts on the first input that affects the run.
- Timer ends on the frame the Mission Complete banner appears.

# Pauses and equalizations

- Timer pauses on the first frame the Oracles flag prompt appears, and resumes on the first input of any player. Players are not permitted to rejoin during this pause; any roster merges must occur before or after the pause has taken place.
- If any player that rejoins after Templar's death is alive at the start of Gatekeepers, the time between the Templar's health being fully depleted and the starting of the Gatekeepers encounter will be set to 53 seconds.

categories.name: Deep Stone Crypt
categories.rules:
# Start and end conditions

- Timer starts on the first input that affects the run.
- Timer ends on the frame the Mission Complete banner appears.

# Pauses and equalizations

- Timer pauses on the frame that the final player collides with either the first entrance airlock door or any part of the wall to the left or right of the door, and resumes on the first input of any player once the second door is open. In addition, players are no longer allowed to go through both airlock doors, and no more than three players may utilize this pause.
- Time pauses on the final input of any player in the Atraks room, and resumes on any player's input. Players must attempt to start the Atraks cutscene upon the roster merging of the rejoining fireteam.

levels.name: The Whisper (Exotic Mission, Unavailable)
levels.rules:
**Timing:**

* Timer STARTS when any player moves from their spawning position and/or performs actions that could affect the speed of the run. Spawning Sparrows before timer start /first movement is allowed.

* Timer ENDS when the “Mission Complete” banner appears.

* The timer is not paused for any wipe screens.

**Rules:**

* Video proof is required for all runs.

**Original audio must be audible for the whole run, however runs with limited or no audio can still be verified at the moderator's discretion**

* Your run may not be tool-assisted i.e. using a macro.

**For Solo:**

* Runs that delay first input in order to unfairly gain super energy before timer start may result in the run being rejected.

**For Duo/Fireteam:**

* Runs may not start with more than 10% super (reached melee icon).

* Runs that break the 10% super rule may be validated at moderator discretion as long as no foul play or super abuse is suspected.

- Timer pauses on the first frame the Lockset rally prompt appears on the skipper's screen, and resumes on the first input of any player upon respawning after the Lockset wipe. In order to use this pause, the skipper must start the Lockset encounter after pausing and rejoin while the remaining members of the fireteam wipe. Upon rejoining, the skipper must immediately start the encounter without rallying while the remaining members receive joining allies. In order to simulate accurate super gains, after starting the encounter, the skipper must die, with a revive being permitted after 10 seconds are left on their respawn timer.

games.name: Destiny 2
games.rules:
# General rules

- Speedrunning is the act of playing a video game with the intent of completing it as fast as possible. Runs will be rejected if this intent is not present, at verifier discretion.
- Original audio must be audible for the whole run. However, runs with limited or no audio may still be verified at verifier discretion.
- Your run may not be tool-assisted in any form, including but not limited to macros, scripts besides the solo script, any form of network manipulation, and cheats.
- Runs with strategies designed around the use of limited time global buffs (such as Solstice Empowerment) will be rejected.
- Strategies exploiting the game's connection-based nature will be reviewed for consistency between fireteams of different player compositions before being permitted.
- Exploits or strategies that Bungie has expressed the intention to patch or have precedent in being patched by Bungie are not permitted until it is clear that they will remain in the game.
- Any glitch listed in [this forum post](https://www.speedrun.com/destiny2/forums/pnnuu) is not allowed in any run.
- For information on artifact mod bans, please see [this thread](https://www.speedrun.com/destiny2/forums/v95ms).

# Submission standards

- Video proof of the entire duration of the run for at least one encounter POV and one POV for each out-of-bounds/skip player is required for all runs. 
- Runs that do not use the activity completion banner as their end condition must demonstrate that the strategy being employed in the run would result in a successful activity completion.
- Supported websites include YouTube, Twitch, and bilibili.
- For top 3 submissions, the POV of the player that makes the first input affecting the run's time is required, and the run will be timed based off of this POV in order to avoid discrepancies.
- Moderators reserve the right to retroactively reject or remove runs where submitted video evidence is deleted, made private, or otherwise inaccessible.
- Corrupted gameplay or gameplay obscured or impacted by overlays may be rejected (non-intrusive overlays such as DDT and threepole are permitted).

# Starting conditions

- Starting with any weapon equipped is allowed, provided that it is not fired or prepped in any way (Lament cannot be charged, Izanagi's Burden cannot be honed, Eager Edge cannot be active, etc.).
- Any run utilizing an ability that a player would not have if they had started the activity immediately upon load-in may be rejected at verifier discretion.
- Valid starting positions are limited to where a player could randomly spawn upon loading into the activity (read category rules for exceptions).

# Timing

- Runs generally end on one of the five following conditions (see category rules for exceptions):

1. Boss healthbar flash/death
2. First frame of mission complete banner
3. First frame of mission summary line
4. Last frame of level visible
5. Frame after interact is filled (empty circle)

  ![](/static/blob/kzwo3d8e.png)

- After cutscenes and loading screens, timer resumes on either the first input that affects the run or optionally when the level becomes visible for the player with the slowest load.
- Runs with strategies involving wipe screens or rejoins will have wipe screens equalized to 17s in raids and 7s in dungeons and levels (timed from leaderboard black screen to first visible spawn frame), while rejoins will be equalized to simulate perfect load times (equalization specifics can be found in category rules).

For more information on category-specific rules, check the individual category rules by clicking "Show rules" at the top right corner of a leaderboard. If you have further questions, feel free to head to our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/d2speedrun).
